record.name: Local Void
record.notes: The void lies largely behind the Milky Way's plane. Tully et al. 2019 give density minima and a bounding box at the -0.7 isodensity of their Wiener-filter density, not a centre; the position is the deepest minimum. Their Mpc figures convert the km/s values with the reconstruction's Hubble constant; the published km/s values are kept. Table 1 of Tully et al. 2019 lists three further Local Void minima (Andromeda-2.3, Aquila-0.8, UMi-3.7). No published dispute was looked for.
